name: vix_filtered_index_trend_5s_3
author: adapted from QuantGen_Subagent_4
thesis: When VIX is low, index trends tend to be slow and steady. When VIX is high, trends are erratic but offer massive reward/risk. Filtering trend breakouts by VIX regime prevents trading noisy chop. Exists due to systemic risk pricing.
mechanism: When multiple timeframe trends align, the probability of continuation increases because institutional flows that established the trend are still active. Trend-following algorithms and discretionary traders pile on, creating a self-reinforcing cycle that lasts until liquidity on the opposing side overwhelms the directional flow.

conditions: india_vix > 20 AND CROSSOVER(ema_9, ema_21) AND close > VWAP(close)
india_vix > 20 AND CROSSUNDER(ema_9, ema_21) AND close < VWAP(close)

weaknesses: VIX is forward-filled and can be lagged intraday
High VIX means wider stop losses are required, reducing position size
Whipsaw risk in contracting volatility environments
adaptation_notes: Converted from 15min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 180x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
